title: Ramayana crosses Rs 900 crore India net in 17 days (Sacnilk: Rs 906.90 cr after Rs 27.40 cr on Day 17, Sat 21 Nov); 4th Indian film past Rs 900 cr net, third-fastest; worldwide Rs 1,616.70 cr
headline: Ramayana Is India's 4th Film Past ₹900 Crore Net, Sacnilk Says
caption:
Ramayana has crossed ₹900 crore net at the Indian box office, trade tracker Sacnilk estimates: ₹906.90 crore in 17 days, after ₹27.40 crore on Saturday, 21 November. By the same count, its worldwide gross is now ₹1,616.70 crore.

On Sacnilk's list, only three Indian films had passed ₹900 crore net in India before it: Pushpa 2 (in 11 days), Dhurandhar 2 (14 days) and Baahubali 2 (19 days). At 17 days, Ramayana is the third-fastest to the mark.

Trackers count differently: Bollywood Hungama's total is lower, and the makers haven't announced a figure.

Have you watched Ramayana in a theatre yet?

Sources: Sacnilk, The Week, Filmibeat, Bollywood Hungama
